stem: An insurance analytics team needs a managed relational engine for advanced JSON processing, custom extension support, and complex SQL query plans.

choices.text: Use MySQL on Amazon RDS for broad compatibility and simpler transactional workloads.
Use PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.
Use MySQL on Amazon RDS with a larger instance class.
Use MariaDB to match PostgreSQL extension behavior.

rationale: The lesson explicitly maps PostgreSQL to advanced JSON handling, complex queries, and custom extensions. MySQL and MariaDB are compatibility-focused options for other workload profiles. A larger instance class adds capacity but does not add PostgreSQL-style extension support.
